name: Violence In The Media
overview: Scripture calls believers to reject all forms of evil and wickedness, deliberately avoiding exposure to corrupting influences as expressed in Psalms 101:3. The fear of the Lord entails a deep hatred for pride, arrogance, and evil behavior, guiding Christians to shun what is morally wrong (Proverbs 8:13). Romans 12:2 urges believers not to conform to worldly patterns but to be transformed through a renewed mind, enabling discernment of God's perfect will. Philippians 4:8 encourages focusing on things that are true, pure, just, and lovely, which stands in direct opposition to the violence and impurity often found in media, thus safeguarding the believer’s heart and mind.
